description: 2026 - Appli suivi trafic is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Bretagne. Dataset allowing the statistical exploitation of data from the form Brittany Channels to detect the passage from boats to locks. Coverage: Région Bretagne. The portal shows the English title as "2026 - Traffic Tracking App" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région Bretagne. Its keywords include patrimoine-tourisme-culture, voies-navigables. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
